title: Polynomial-Time Closure Under Composition Map
statement: Let $a_1,k_1,a_2,k_2\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings. For a bit string $z$ that decodes as a pair $(u,v)$, form $z_1=\langle u, v_{\le L_1}\rangle$, where $L_1=a_1(|u|+1)^{k_1}$ and $v_{\le L_1}$ is the prefix of $v$ of length at most $L_1$. Decode the remaining suffix after that prefix as the second component of a pair, apply $f$ to $z_1$, pair its output with that suffix, and truncate the resulting second component to length $L_2=a_2(|f(z_1)|+1)^{k_2}$. The function on bit strings defined by this procedure, using empty strings for failed pair decodings, is polynomial-time computable.
